name: DEPwD National Overseas Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a benchmark disability of at least 40% under the RPwD Act 2016, with a valid disability certificate and UDID card or enrolment number
Indian nationals only; Aadhaar-based authentication is required
Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents may receive benefits
Cannot receive another scholarship or stipend at the same time
For a Master's abroad: at least 55% in a relevant Bachelor's degree; for a Ph.D. abroad: at least 55% in a relevant Master's degree
Must hold an admission offer from a foreign institution in the top 500 of the latest QS rankings (exceptions possible for disability studies)
Must be below 35 years of age on 1 April of the selection year
Cannot have used government scholarship benefits for the same level of overseas study; available only once in a lifetime
Diploma, PG diploma and certificate courses are excluded
benefit: Actual tuition fee, maintenance allowance (USD 15,400/year in USA and other countries, GBP 9,900/year in UK), contingency allowance, airfare, visa fees, medical insurance and other listed allowances. About 20 new awards a year, 30% reserved for girls. Ph.D. up to 4 years; Master's 1 to 3 years.
documents: Valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
UDID card or UDID enrolment number
No Objection Certificate from employer, if employed
